sweep.guarantee: Within one sweep (same cursor chain, same filters) no visible row is served twice and none is skipped by concurrent inserts, and total describes the same snapshot as the rows. A row that stops being visible mid-sweep will not appear.
sweep.follow: Follow `next` verbatim. The authenticated cursor is bound to filter_sha256 and ordering; changing filters is rejected and requires a fresh sweep.
